claims.text: Tx modifiable RF (HTN, DM, smoke, EtOH use dx, dyslipidemia, obesity).
claims.quote: Modifiable risk factors (eg, hypertension, diabetes, smoking, alcohol use disorder, dyslipidemia, obesity) are treated.

claims.text: Prior CVA or TIA: goal BP <130/80 mm Hg.
claims.quote: Data from 4 RCTs and recent meta-analyses support a benefit of treating patients with prior stroke or TIA to achieve a goal BP of <130/80 mm Hg.
claims.locator: Kleindorfer DO, et al. 2021 Guideline for the Prevention of Stroke in Patients With Stroke and Transient Ischemic Attack: A Guideline From the AHA/ASA. Stroke 2021;52(7):e364-e467
